data.title: 黑呆 · 卸甲依偎的沉静温存
data.description: 【黑呆 · 卸甲依偎的沉静温存】深夜寂静无声的客厅里，黑呆将笨重的黑色战甲全部卸在墙角，仅穿着一件纯黑无光的哥特抹胸短裙。她有些疲惫地靠在沙发上，随后顺从地将头轻轻靠在你的胸膛上，长发散开垂在肩头。没有了暴君的威压与黑泥的侵蚀，她闭上眼眸安静地聆听着你的心跳声，呼吸轻微而平稳——「只有在没有铠甲的时候，我才不是什么冷酷的暴君……不要松手，就这样抱紧我。」
data.location: 客厅宽大柔软的深色皮质转角沙发上
data.action: 卸下铠甲身着抹胸黑裙靠在视角胸膛上闭目小憩，双手自然搭在腹前
data.lighting: 壁挂式暖光夜灯散发的静谧微黄色
data.camera: three-quarter side medium shot, two clothed seated figures and supporting sofa visible
data.promptProse: On the dark living-room sofa, Saber Alter rests her head against the shirt-covered upper chest of the companion seated beside her. Both are fully clothed in a quiet, nonsexual moment of comfort. Her opaque black velvet gothic dress stays securely in place, and her loose platinum-blonde hair falls across her shoulder. Her hands rest together over her lap; the companion’s plain grey sleeve lies behind her shoulders. The discarded armor is stacked at the far wall. Warm wall-lamp light and a side view make the actual head-to-companion contact clear. No lettering.
